title: A Locally Penalized Cross-Estimate Federated Method with Guarantees for Constrained Personalized Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient framework for solving distributed optimization problems. Standard FL methods aggregate local updates into a single global model that is shared by all agents, effectively imposing consensus. Under heterogeneous local constraints, however, a common feasible model may be overly restrictive or may not exist. Existing constrained FL methods largely retain this shared-model structure and therefore do not directly address personalization under heterogeneous agent-specific feasible sets.
